passages.original: Yigesimus sextus, Epitritus tertius, ex tertia brevi et tribus longis, ut Demosthenes, temporum septem.
passages.english: The twenty-sixth, the third epitrite, [is made] of a short third [syllable] and three longs, as in "Dēmosthĕnēs", [and is] of seven time-units.
passages.notes: "Yigesimus" is a scanning error for "Vigesimus" (twenty-sixth). The third epitrite is long–long–short–long; "ex tertia brevi" means the third syllable is short, as in Dē-mŏs-thĕ-nēs? Strictly, the Latin scansion of Demosthenes is Dē-mōs-thĕ-nēs (long, long, short, long), which fits the description.
